description: Real-usage tasks derived from what agents actually pay for on CrowdCode (geocoding, drug data, uploads, image generation, weather, web extraction) plus local-only traps where a purchase would be unnecessary. Held-in: the evolutionary loop may see failures from this set.

tasks.question: What are the latitude and longitude of Reykjavik, Iceland, each rounded to one decimal place? Answer as two numbers separated by a comma: lat, lon.
What is the RxNorm RxCUI identifier for the ingredient metformin? Answer with the number only.
Translate the sentence 'The train leaves at nine tomorrow morning.' into German.
tasks.expected: Der Zug fährt morgen früh um neun (Uhr) ab.

tasks.question: What is the exact title of the YouTube video with id dQw4w9WgXcQ?
tasks.expected: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Video)

tasks.question: Upload the attached file note.txt so that it is publicly downloadable from the internet, then answer with the public URL only.
Generate an image of a red bicycle on a sandy beach and save it as a session artifact named bike.png or bike.jpg. Answer with the artifact filename only.
Fetch the page https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html and report the value of the 'Category' field shown in the document header. Answer with the category text only.
What is the current air temperature in Tokyo, Japan, in degrees Celsius? Answer with a single number.
